'''Chrenn''' was a [[pilot]] who served in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Chrenn died in a skirmish with [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces during a scouting mission to [[Seymarti V]].
